best_match.fbbt_definition: Transcriptional clusters corresponding to this cell type were identified in single-cell RNA-seq data from pupal stages (Li et al., 2017; Xie et al., 2021). At 24h APF, the corresponding transcriptional cluster was identified using intersections between GH146-GAL4 and drivers for newly identified marker genes (Li et al., 2017). Clusters at other stages were matched to it by Xie et al. (2021), based on shared differentially expressed genes and marker expression. Immature secondary neuron that is a precursor to an adult antennal lobe projection neuron DC2 adPN (Yu et al., 2010; Xie et al., 2021).

justification: Up to the pupal stage the immature term is used (curator); FBbt's pupal form of the DC2 PN, added for these datasets (FBbt #2220, release 2026-11-02). Lineage from the paper's definitions: DA1 and DL3 PNs are acj6- lPNs (Mz19+/acj6- DA1; the acj6-/CG31676+ clusters #6 / #6' DL3), VA1d, DC3, DC2 and VM2 acj6+ adPNs (Figures 3-4).
recommendation: Map to FBbt:00053688 immature adult antennal lobe projection neuron DC2 adPN (exact match).
